verdict.rationale: The evidence covers many online services: annual reports, CCFS search, business formation and closure, foreign registration, certificates, apostilles, trademarks, and downloadable forms. None of it mentions a public API, developer docs, or programmatic access to these functions. The only probe found a DOR portal serving a JavaScript app shell, which suggests a UI-only experience rather than an API. Programmatic access is a fair axis for a government filing service, so the lack of any API evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".
